title: Creative Infographic Designer - Remote Job
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
Turn your creativity into paid work!

Kaya by Chemin is looking for creative contributors to create original infographics for an AI data collection project.

If you enjoy creating visual content and have experience with infographic design, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work and earn from your creativity. Students and early-stage creatives are welcome. You don't need to be a professional designer!
key_responsibilities:
What You'll Do:
- Create original infographic designs based on project requirements.
- Use Figma or Illustrator that supports the required SVG output
- Can't use Figma or Illustrator, but you can design, no worries! We will guide you how to use the tools.
- Submit your designs in SVG format while preserving the correct element structure.
- You can also submit your previous infographic designs.

Important SVG requirements:
- Text must remain text elements, not be converted into vector paths.
- Vector shapes must remain vector elements.
- Images must remain image elements, not be converted into vector paths.
- All submissions must follow the project's technical and quality guidelines.

Who Can Apply?
- Students, aspiring designers, and creative contributors are welcome.
- You have experience creating infographics or other visual content.
- You can use a design tool that exports SVG files with the required element structure.
- You can follow detailed instructions and meet the project's quality requirements.
- You have the rights to submit your work and grant the required ownership rights.

Professional design experience is not required, but attention to detail and the ability to follow technical guidelines are important.

Project Details
- Project period: 19 October
- 10 November 2026
- Output format: SVG
- Design tools: Figma or Illustrator to produce SVG files meeting the project requirements

Important Guidelines
- All work must be human-created. AI-generated, including AI-generated backgrounds, is not allowed.
- Do not submit downloaded designs as-is. All submissions must be original.
- Do not include watermarks, logos, brands or trademarks, blurry or pixelated visuals, or personally identifiable information.
- Do not submit work containing third-party copyrighted material or designs owned by others.
- You must have the rights to submit your work and grant the required ownership rights.
- Submissions that do not meet the project requirements may be rejected and will not be eligible for payment.

Earn from Your Designs!

Get USD 30 for 10 infographics submitted!

Earn USD 3 for every accepted infographic. You can submit more designs and increase your total earnings based on the number of infographics accepted by the client.

Payment is based on accepted submissions, so make sure your designs and submissions meet the project requirements.

Interested?

Have the skills to create original infographics and produce properly structured SVG files?

Apply now to join Kaya by Chemin's SVG Infographic Collection project!
